name: Relais Roncolo 1888
positioning: Countryside relais on Tenuta di Roncolo, an organic wine and balsamic vinegar estate in the Apennine foothills between Parma and Reggio Emilia, with rooms in the 17th-century Villa Manodori and its restored outbuildings
best_for: Food and wine lovers who want balsamic vinegar and wine tastings on a working organic estate
Travelers who want frescoed historic rooms and countryside walking and biking

facts.text: The Tenuta di Roncolo estate is in the foothills of the Apennine mountains between Parma and Reggio Emilia.
The village of Roncolo, home to the estate, is part of the town of Quattro Castella.
Villa Manodori, the villa at the heart of the estate, dates to 1670.
Rooms and suites in Villa Manodori combine original frescoes with contemporary furnishings.
Rooms in the historic outbuildings known as the Dimore have original wooden beams and are furnished with natural fabrics and modern antiques.
The relais has a seasonal pool and a gym.
The estate has been certified organic since 1994 and a certified B Corp since 2025.
The estate is almost entirely energy self-sufficient, powered by solar panels, and is plastic-free.
Ristorante Limonaia is in the estate's converted historic greenhouse, with a terrace overlooking the vineyards and gardens.
The estate is surrounded by the Parco di Roncolo nature preservation area and offers many kilometers of trails.
Mountain bikes and electric bikes are available to rent.

highlights.text: Guests can take a guided tasting tour of the estate's historic Acetaia di Canossa, where wooden barrels age traditional balsamic vinegar over decades.
The Manodori Master Suite has hand-painted fresco ceilings, a separate sitting room, a four-poster super-king bed, a deep tub and views over the historic park.
The estate's classic Alfa Romeo Spider and Fiat Abarth can be rented on request.
Sommeliers lead tastings of Venturini Baldini wines in the historic wine cellar of the seventeenth-century Dimora Ancini.
The Dimora Garden Suite is a ground-floor suite with its own private garden or terrace opening onto the estate.

considerations.text: This is a countryside estate in the Apennine foothills between Parma and Reggio Emilia, not a city hotel.
Golf is off-site: the 18-hole Terre di Canossa Golf Club is ten minutes from the estate.
